mealTr: O gürültü koparacak olanın ne olduğunu sen bilir misin?
mealEn: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?
mealDe: Und was läßt dich wissen, was das Verhängnis ist?
mealFr: Et qui te dira ce qu'est le fracas?

mealTr: O gün insanlar, ateş etrafında çırpınıp dökülen pervaneye dönecekler.
mealEn: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,
mealDe: Am Tag, da die Menschen wie flatternde Motten sein werden
mealFr: C'est le jour où les gens seront comme des papillons éparpillés,

mealEn: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.
mealDe: und die Berge wie zerflockte gefärbte Wolle sein werden.
mealFr: et les montagnes comme de la laine cardée;

mealTr: Ama tartıları ağır gelen kimse hoş bir hayat içinde olacaktır.
mealEn: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],
mealDe: Was nun jemanden angeht, dessen Waagschalen schwer sind,
mealFr: quant à celui dont la balance sera lourde

mealTr: Ama tartıları ağır gelen kimse hoş bir hayat içinde olacaktır.
mealEn: He will be in a pleasant life.
mealDe: so wird er in einem zufriedenen Leben sein.
mealFr: il sera dans une vie agréable;

mealEn: But as for one whose scales are light,
mealDe: Was aber jemanden angeht, dessen Waagschalen leicht sind,
mealFr: et quant à celui dont la balance sera légère,

mealEn: His refuge will be an abyss.
mealDe: dessen Mutter wird ein Abgrund sein.
mealFr: sa mère [destination] est un abîme très profond.

mealTr: O çukurun ne olduğunu sen bilir misin?
mealEn: And what can make you know what that is?
mealDe: Und was läßt dich wissen, was das ist?
mealFr: Et qui te dira ce que c'est?

mealEn: It is a Fire, intensely hot.
